Definition: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code for the country
The year in which the finance was approved or committed. In some circumstances this may be a planned, rather than actual, start year.

The short or abbreviated name of the institution providing the finance

The committed value of  the finance in millions of US dollars. If the commitment was made in a different currency this is reported in the original amount column and has been converted to USD using IMF annual average rates.

Commitments are used in this table as data on actual disbursements is often missing. There are a few transactions where only a disbursement, rather than commitment, figure is available. This column records this.
Data in this table is collected from a variety of sources, including the press. This column attempts to assess the reliability of the data.
